exception.rationale: The workflow preserves shared Git state, explicit-path staging, and remote authorization. The revision binds delivery preflight to the exact authorized base/head, all unpublished changes and their required evidence, and actual mandatory remote capabilities before readiness or publication. Local installation does not substitute for publish approval, and unavailable protections cannot be bypassed. No fabricated comparison or human approval is recorded.
